k:牧.mnemonic: A herder gives the cow (牛) a light strike (攵) with a switch to steer it to the best grass. He feeds the herd, tends it and raises its calves. Breed (care for, shepherd, pasture).
k:牧.hint: Herder steering a cow to grass.

k:吹.mnemonic: A mouth (口) puffing until you lack (欠) breath: cheeks out, lips rounded, trying to put out every candle on the cake in one go. Blow (breathe, puff, emit).

k:困.mnemonic: A tree (木) with a fence (囗) built tight around it. It cannot spread its branches, cannot be moved and cannot be felled without wrecking the fence. Quandary (become distressed, annoyed).
k:困.hint: Tree boxed in on all sides.

k:奥.mnemonic: The rice (米) is kept under a hood (冂) at the very back of the house, with a big (大) man sitting on the floor to guard it. Visitors never get that far in. Interior (heart, mind).
k:奥.hint: Rice guarded deep in the house.

k:栄.mnemonic: A tree (木) whose crown, its leafy forehead (冖), is covered in sparkle (⺌): blossom catching the light on every branch. The tree is at its glorious best. Flourish (prosperity, honor, glory).

k:沿.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) of river water squeezes toward its mouth (口) at the sea, and the road keeps to the bank the whole way down, never leaving the water's side. Run alongside (follow along, run along, lie along).

k:那.mnemonic: A stranger walks into the borough (阝) carrying a sword (刀) with two extra notches cut in the blade. Every head turns, and every mouth says the same word. What?

k:聴.mnemonic: An ear (耳) that works like a net (罒), catching ten (十) words out of ten, with the heart (心) underneath taking every one of them in. Listen (hear, careful inquiry).
k:聴.hint: Ear like a net, heart below.

k:盛.mnemonic: A dish (皿) heaped so high that it has become (成) a mountain of food. Every plate overflows, every seat is taken, and business has never been better. Boom (prosper).

k:批.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) point at two paintings hung side by side to compare (比) them: this one is crooked, that one is dull. Every jab of the finger finds a fault. Criticism (strike).

k:混.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) churns the harbour for a whole day (日). Afterwards the fishermen compare (比) their catches and cannot tell whose is whose: everything is stirred into one heap. Mix (blend, confuse).
k:混.hint: Catches stirred together by the waves.

k:恋.mnemonic: Six (六) love letters in a single week, each one pressed against the heart (心) and read again at night. The heart counts to six and longs for a seventh. Romance (in love, yearn for, miss).
k:恋.hint: Six letters held to the chest.

k:骨.mnemonic: A skull on top with a notch where the joint fits, resting on a frame of bare ribs. It is what stays standing when everything soft is gone. Skeleton (bone, remains, frame).

k:勤.mnemonic: A gardener rises early: three (三) barrows of soil (土) to the beds each morning, and then she adds (加) one more row of flowers (艹). Never a day missed. Diligence (become employed, serve).
k:勤.hint: Three barrows before breakfast, every day.

k:悲.mnemonic: An injustice (非) pressing down on a heart (心). The heart knows it was wronged and can do nothing but ache under the weight. Sad (grieve, deplore, regret).
k:悲.hint: A wrong weighing on the heart.

k:詩.mnemonic: What you say (言) at the temple (寺): slow, measured words chanted in rhythm, each line weighed before it is spoken. Poem (poetry).
k:詩.hint: Measured words chanted at the temple.

k:鳴.mnemonic: A bird (鳥) with its mouth (口) wide open: the sound that comes from the branch outside your window at sunrise. Chirp (cry, bark, sound).

k:杯.mnemonic: At the altar (礻) under the old tree (木) the wedding guests raise their cups ten thousand (万) times, one toast for every year of happiness they wish the couple. Wine glass (glass, toast).
k:杯.hint: Countless toasts under the old tree.

k:郷.mnemonic: A tiny (幺) borough (阝) full of stubborn (艮) old folk who never moved away. However far you travel, it is the small place that stubbornly stays in you. Home village (hometown, native place, village).
k:郷.hint: Tiny borough of stubborn old folk.

k:損.mnemonic: A club member (員) lets the trophy slip through his fingers (扌). It hits the floor, a handle snaps off, and the member has to pay for it. Damage (loss, disadvantage, hurt).
k:損.hint: Trophy slips and a handle snaps.

k:泊.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) warning keeps the white (白) boat tied up in harbour until morning, its white sails furled and its crew asleep at the inn. Overnight stay (put up at, ride at anchor).
k:泊.hint: White boat tied up till morning.

k:激.mnemonic: After an overnight stay (泊) penned behind the dam, the water gets its release (放): the gates open and it explodes down the valley, tossing boulders aside. Violent (get excited, enraged, incite).
k:激.hint: Dam gates open, water explodes out.

k:埼.mnemonic: A big (大) finger of soil (土) pointing out into the sea from the coast of Asia (亜), with a lighthouse on its tip and waves on three sides. Cape (spit, promontory).
k:埼.hint: Finger of land with a lighthouse.

k:普.mnemonic: People standing in a row (並) under the day (日) sun. The same light falls on every single person in the row, wherever they are, and nobody is left out. Universal (widely, generally, Prussia).
k:普.hint: Same sunlight on everyone in line.

k:怪.mnemonic: Your heartbeat (忄) quickens: the soil (土) by the gate has been freshly dug, and behind the shed it is dug up also (又). Someone has been burying things at night. Suspicious (mystery, apparition).
k:怪.hint: Freshly dug earth in two places.

k:迎.mnemonic: You come up the path (辶) and the host is already kneeling at the door with a stamp (卩) to mark your guest card. He came out to meet you before you knocked. Welcome (meet, greet).
k:迎.hint: Host kneeling ready at the door.

k:願.mnemonic: The original (原) page (頁), signed by the whole village and carried by hand to the lord: please grant us what we wish for. Petition (request, vow, wish).
k:願.hint: Signed page carried to the lord.

k:伸.mnemonic: The leader (亻) asks wherefore (由) the banner hangs so short, then rises on his toes and pulls it out to its full length. Extend (stretch, expand, lengthen).
k:伸.hint: Leader on tiptoe pulling a banner.

k:韓.mnemonic: At the day (日) market an old (古) craftsman sells drums of tanned hide (韋), the kind beaten in the farmers' dances of the peninsula east of China. Korea.

k:税.mnemonic: The collector arrives on brisk legs (儿), and the harmony (和) of the village is over: a share of every household's grain goes into his sack. Tax (duty, task, job).
k:税.hint: Collector's legs end the village calm.
